title: sell() keeps a second value override beside `cost`: the `sell_value` prop replaces sale_price(it) after it is computed (gear.py:168). Fold it into the item valuation, e.g. a `sale_price` hook on Item that honours `sell_value` and otherwise halves listed_cost(), so selling has one value mechanism. Also the sale_price docstring says trade goods keep full value, but the function always halves.
